stem:
Each of a random sample of 80 adults gave an estimate, $h$ metres, of the height of a particular building. The results were summarised as follows.

$$n = 80 \qquad \Sigma h = 2048 \qquad \Sigma h^2 = 52\,760$$

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Calculate unbiased estimates of the population mean and variance.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Using this sample, the upper boundary of an $\alpha$% confidence interval for the population mean is 26.0.

Find the value of $\alpha$.
